title: Workshops
intro: Hands-on workshops led by a vet, for rescuers, multi-cat homes and anyone caring for a cat who needs treatment at home. Learn the simple, safe skills that save you trips to the clinic and money.
why: Our share of every workshop goes straight to our rescue cats: food, treatment and care.
note: Every workshop is taught by a licensed vet. We only teach simple, safe skills for treatments your own vet has prescribed. Anything that needs a vein, like catheters, stays at the clinic.

workshops.title: Giving injections at home
workshops.body: How to give injections under the skin and into the muscle, and how to finish an antibiotic course properly.

workshops.title: Fluids at home for kidney cats
workshops.body: Your vet sets up the line at the clinic, and you learn to give the fluids safely at home. A big saving for cats in later stages of kidney disease.
workshops.for: Owners of cats with kidney failure

workshops.title: Everyday home care
workshops.body: Giving pills and eye drops, cleaning eyes and ears, and trimming nails without stress.

workshops.title: Caring for a paralyzed cat
workshops.body: Expressing the bladder, keeping them clean, diapers, and daily routines that keep them comfortable.
workshops.for: Owners and fosters of paralyzed cats

videos_body: A video series of homemade treats and meals, reviewed by a veterinary nutritionist. Each recipe will say clearly whether it is a treat or a complete meal, because homemade food is often missing important nutrients for cats.
ask_body: Tell us which workshop you are interested in. Once enough people sign up, we will share the dates, place and price.
